question.knowledge_point: Finding the Transpose of a Matrix
question.worked_solution:
To find the transpose, we interchange the rows and columns:

$$
{D}^{T}=[\begin{aligned}3 & 3 \\ 1 & 4 \\ 2 & 2\end{aligned}]
$$
